evidence.quoted_text: any(compatible(item[key], spec) for item in matches),
evidence.reason: The assertion at line 80 only requires one matching fixture item to be compatible with the manifest type spec. Since `matches` already contains every item of that kind having the key, a mixed fixture such as one string and one integer passes when the spec is `"str"`. The same test gap exists for event and work values at lines 102 and 111. Using `all(...)` after the existing nonempty assertion enforces the intended per-value type coverage without breaking union specifications, so this is a routine test-correctness repair.
